collision_audit.result: no filename-embedded seed inside 1400000..1400063 anywhere in the versioned project or the sibling working directories; no overlap with any registered claim range; the only pre-existing seed-vocabulary mention is this round's own planning document; fallback first-64 also available
collision_audit.method: read-only metadata: artefact filenames across the repo and siblings, plus a text scan of docs/protocols/harness code for the block; protected-set contents were not read
registered_claim_ranges_not_touched: 1301000..1301015 (ROUND22/24 development scenarios, kept as development history only)

scene_identity.rule: the scenario seed is the only changed key of the ROUND24-inherited world configuration (the same provenance rule the round-18 runner used for new seeds); the initial map/goals/fleet/search/allocation weights and the channel RNG attachment all follow from it
scene_identity.reproducibility: stage_b_inherited_config(seed) -> RunConfiguration -> build_joint_run; the ROUND24 freeze proved this path byte-stable per seed
scene_identity.no_difficulty_swap: the list is frozen before any scene is generated or inspected; no scene is replaced after seeing difficulty or results

exogenous_randomness.environment_and_channel: come from the scenario seed inside the driver; identical for all three arms of a scene
exogenous_randomness.learned_action_stream: eval_action_seed(training_seed=33, scenario_seed, mode='greedy') with label 'round24-eval', inherited verbatim from the ROUND24 final_greedy block so the learned arm's RNG derivation is identical to the ROUND24 evaluated block
exogenous_randomness.greedy_draws_no_samples: the greedy decode draws no random action; the stream is seeded identically so nothing else can drift
exogenous_randomness.same_seed_caveat: the same scenario seed does not make the three arms experience the same packet losses message by message: policies change the message set and therefore the downstream states; the channel RNG is not modified to prettify the pairing

pooling_rule: the old 16 development scenes are never merged with these 64 scenes in any statistic of this round

arms.late_discovery_gate_147: original LateDiscoveryGatePolicy, cut_steps=147.0, original boundary and implementation
